description: This PHP class represents a controller in a Human Resource Management system (OrangeHRM). It handles requests related to exporting language packages in XLIFF format, performing authorization checks, fetching language data, and returning the generated file as a response.

classes.name: LanguagePackage
classes.description: A controller class that manages exporting language packages as XLIFF files for specific language IDs. It validates language status, retrieves the language data, and serves the content as a downloadable file.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request to export a language package. It retrieves the language ID from request attributes, verifies language status, exports the language file content, and sets appropriate headers for download response.
